data.name: Daisy la Fleur
data.detailed_description:
Daisy la Fleur is an art nouveau action-adventure inspired by classic retro fantasy games.

Journey through a 1900's France filled with ornamental towns, antiquated festivities, and strange happenings. As Daisy, you must battle alien creatures, uncover hidden secrets, and survive a land where something has gone terribly, terribly wrong!

Armed with an arsenal of unusual weapons and the gumption to fix what's wrong with the world, Daisy must explore dangerous landscapes and confront the forces responsible for the darkness that has befallen the world.

The world of Daisy la Fleur blends eerie atmosphere, beautiful worlds and dark storytelling, creating an adventure filled with mystery, humor, and danger.

Features

Classic Action-Adventure Combat
Fight enemies using a variety of melee weapons and tools as you battle through cursed lands.

Explore an Art Nouveau Fantasy World
Travel through ornamental towns, wacky circuses, bizarre farmlands, and old-fashioned theatres.

Secrets and Hidden Paths
Discover hidden areas, secrets, and strange characters scattered throughout the world.

Easy to Navigate World
Everything has been designed with a focus on keeping each zone unique, interesting and non-labyrinthian.

Retro-Inspired Adventure
Experience gameplay inspired by classic console action adventures with modern improvements.

data.short_description: A PS1-esque art nouveau action-adventure game inspired by classic 90s games. Something strange has arrived in early 1900's France! It looks like Daisy is the one to stop it! Uncover the mystery behind these, tentacle monsters, jelly fish creatures, and even escaped brains! Welcome to Daisy la Fleur!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5-4460 / AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 750 Ti / Radeon HD 7850
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel i7 or Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060 / RX 580
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
